name: kubernetes-api
description: OctoBus package for Kubernetes API read-only operations (namespaces, pods, services, deployments, nodes, pod logs).

Kubernetes_API.Kubernetes_API/ListPods.name: list-pods
Kubernetes_API.Kubernetes_API/ListPods.description: List Kubernetes pods in a namespace or across all namespaces.

Kubernetes_API.Kubernetes_API/GetPod.name: get-pod
Kubernetes_API.Kubernetes_API/GetPod.description: Get a single Kubernetes pod by name and namespace.

Kubernetes_API.Kubernetes_API/GetPodLogs.name: get-pod-logs
Kubernetes_API.Kubernetes_API/GetPodLogs.description: Get logs from a Kubernetes pod.
